fusions.name: Anvil Beat
fusions.desc: A heavy, even blow that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Flattening Finish
fusions.desc: A finishing blow that deals 28 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Seasoned Plate
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Compounding Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
